mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.54% is at a historically low level, indicating an accommodative monetary policy that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns within 20 trading days of 2017-01-15.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in CPIAUCSL above 242.5 (current level 242.348) signals accelerating inflation, which triggers a sell-off in equities due to rising real interest rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns within 20 trading days of CPIAUCSL crossing 242.5.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate is below 4.5% and industrial production is above 103.5 (current level), the economy is in a strong expansion phase, which supports equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In instances where UNRATE < 4.5 and INDPRO > 103.5, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward 20-day returns due to rising real interest rates and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: In periods where FEDFUNDS > 1.0%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1080 (current level 1090.0) signals weakening demand in the housing sector, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns due to reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1080 but 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor force (PAYEMS) is expanding above 145,000 thousand and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.8%, the economy is in a strong labor market phase, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: In instances where PAYEMS > 145000 and UNRATE < 4.8, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (current level 103.8589) signals an economic contraction, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns due to reduced corporate earnings and increased recession risk.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 but 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 468,000 million dollars (current level 469,092) signals weakening consumer demand, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: RSAFS < 468000 but 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.
